name: Melbourne
industries: The Big Build infrastructure program, banking and insurance, health sciences and a strong tech scene share Melbourne's market.
intro:
Melbourne pairs Australia's biggest infrastructure program with its liveliest digital economy: the Big Build's rail tunnels and level-crossing removals employ program talent in volume, while the city's banks, insurers and health networks run transformation portfolios of their own. Victoria's government sector adds steady certified-role demand. Scrum credentials carry the tech scene from Cremorne to Docklands; PMP anchors the infrastructure and corporate side. There are live online batches all year for Melbourne — pick a Saturday–Sunday weekend or a Wednesday–Thursday weekday cohort — each timed to fall within normal Melbourne working-day hours; the schedule below gives the precise local start and end for every date. Constant throughout: live weekend instruction, exam application guidance, calibrated mocks, and trainer access until certification. Melbourne cohorts often pair Big Build contractors with bank delivery leads in the same room.

Melbourne's project demand is institutional at its core: superannuation funds and insurers run perpetual regulatory portfolios, the health and education sectors manage program-scale modernization, and the infrastructure agenda keeps delivery roles moving through the market. Employers here are process-mature and read certification as fluency in the governance they already run. Training is live online across two consecutive days shown in Melbourne local time on this page — no tram to a training venue, no leave. Victorian compensation for certified project roles tracks close behind Sydney's; the sourced Melbourne entries below give this market's own dated figures. The employer list shows the funds-health-infrastructure mix hiring certified talent, and institutions can certify program offices together via private cohorts.
